goal: Implement and live-verify exact-only ResolvedLoadout and immutable SimulationSnapshot contracts, a deterministic canonical SimC compiler, append-only persistence, and task compatibility without changing the active Manifest pointer.
userValue: A saved equipment template resolves into one legal, reproducible gear set and every simulation executes the exact immutable profile the player confirmed.
nonGoals: Do not switch the active Catalog, Community or Season Manifest pointer in this phase.
Do not infer exact keys for Phase 2 partial references or rewrite sealed Phase 1/2 rows.
Do not create frontend SimC serialization or change current product entry routes.
Do not delete the compatibility Resolver before the later explicit cutover.

mustChange: Add pure deterministic ResolvedLoadout identity and exact-registry parity validation.
Add pure SimulationSnapshot identity and canonical SimC compiler.
Add append-only PostgreSQL loadout/snapshot persistence and migration.
Bind canonical template tasks and fingerprints to immutable snapshot identity.
mustNotChange: Do not mutate the active Manifest pointer or sealed Catalog/Exact rows.
Do not allow partial exact references into ready loadouts.
Do not let frontend-authored facts or raw template text become canonical SimC input.
Do not alter historical task results.
riskUnknown: Phase 2 exact serializer values may reveal legacy Resolver parity gaps.
Some of the 80 Community templates contain one or more of the 55 explicit partial references and must remain blocked.
Task request compatibility must preserve old rows while preventing canonical input drift.
evidenceRequired: RED/GREEN tests for exact-only loadout identity, slot order, parity, revision and fail-closed behavior.
Compiler/snapshot tests proving byte determinism and 26 supported versus 14 unsupported gating.
Append-only store/migration and task request/fingerprint/runner compatibility tests.
Production candidate classification for all 80 templates, real 26/14 SimC matrix, pointer fence, resource and rollback evidence.
Full Harness, PR CI, merge, local/origin/cloud parity and cleanup.

ownership.factOwner: The current Resolver owns whole-loadout legality; Phase 2 exact validation owns concrete item/static/serializer facts; the new Loadout builder owns their immutable join; the Snapshot compiler owns canonical execution bytes.

engineeringHealth.reason: This phase adds PostgreSQL state and changes the canonical task execution boundary. TDD, exact parity, immutable input, full candidate SimC and rollback evidence are mandatory.

acceptanceEvidence: Only verified Phase 2 exact references can produce a ready ResolvedLoadout.
Same canonical inputs produce identical loadout keys, snapshot keys, SimC bytes and input hashes.
All 80 active Community templates are classified with no silent drop.
All 26 supported specializations execute real SimC and all 14 unsupported specializations block before task insertion.
New tasks persist and execute one immutable snapshot while old task reads remain compatible.
The active Manifest pointer remains generation 32 and local/origin/cloud identities match.

decisionLog.decision: The user authorized Codex to self-test and continue automatically without waiting for manual confirmation.
ResolvedLoadout reuses the existing Resolver legality and consumes only Phase 2 verified exact references; it does not duplicate legality rules.
SimulationSnapshot stores canonical input and binds Catalog, Rule, Compiler and Runtime revisions; unsupported specializations fail before task insertion.
